answer: An agent economy resists sybils by anchoring every identity inside the canyon, a state ledger that groups agents by their shared settlement channels. To stay active, each spawned raven must continuously pay to wander, defined as an exponentially rising ETH fee burned per epoch to renew decaying transaction capacity. Because clones clearing payments through the same settlement hub collide in the same canyon slot, every extra raven multiplies the ETH burn required for all siblings to wander, pricing the attacker out unless off-chain mixers obscure settlement links.
